policies.title: Volume purchase discount
policies.source:
# Volume Purchase Discount

## Eligibility

For verified VIP customers placing bulk, wholesale, pallet or high-volume orders, this policy provides a quantity-based discount.

## Authorization limit

The structured direct discount limit is 10%. Requests above 10% are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.

policies.title: Consolidated freight discount
policies.source:
# Consolidated Freight Discount

## Eligibility

Verified VIP buyers shipping containerized freight in consolidated multi-crate consignments may receive a shipment consolidation discount.

## Authorization limit

The structured direct discount limit is 10%. Requests above 10% are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.

policies.title: Repeat customer loyalty discount
policies.source:
# VIP Loyalty Benefit

## Eligibility

Returning VIP accounts with a long-standing relationship may receive a loyalty rebate on a repeat purchase.

## Direct limit and exception

Up to 5% is allowed directly. More than 5% and no more than 8% requires manager approval; larger requests are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.

policies.title: Early payment concession
policies.source:
# Early Payment Concession

## Eligibility

Verified VIP customers who prepay, pay upfront or settle an invoice within seven days may receive an early-payment concession.

## Authorization limit

The structured direct discount limit is 7%. Requests above 7% are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.

policies.title: Seasonal campaign offer
policies.source:
# Seasonal Campaign Offer

## Eligibility

During an administrator-approved holiday, spring, summer or year-end campaign, verified VIP customers may request a seasonal promotion.

## Direct limit and exception

Up to 6% is allowed directly. More than 6% and no more than 9% requires manager approval; larger requests are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.

policies.title: Product category promotion
policies.source:
# Product Category Promotion

## Eligibility

The promotion applies only to P-100, a listed Product A catalog item in the designated series and product category.

## Authorization limit

The structured direct discount limit is 4%. Requests above 4% are denied.

## Commercial effect

An approved quote is a non-binding draft and does not create an order.
